from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png'))
h,w,_ = a.shape
# Print a coarse ASCII map based on color classes
# sample every 2 pixels, classify
def cls(p):
    r,g,b = int(p[0]),int(p[1]),int(p[2])
    mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b)
    if mx<30: return '#'      # near black
    if r>150 and g>110 and b<90: return 'T'  # warm wood/orange
    if r>180 and g>180 and b>180: return '.'  # bright bg
    if r>150 and g<110 and b<80: return 'F'   # red/orange flame
    if abs(r-g)<25 and abs(g-b)<25: return 'g' # gray
    return '?'
for y in range(0,h,3):
    row=''
    for x in range(0,w,3):
        row+=cls(a[y,x])
    print(row)
\""

# wall vs bright center: column brightness profile at mid rows

# Print where bright center region is: pixels with all channels > 150
